+title: 'T1: no time limit, sleep or poll in the tests'
+---
+## Rule T1
+
+Remove each `.timeLimit`, `Task.sleep`, `BoundedWait` and `AwaitedCondition` sleep poll from the tests. Each wait in a test must also end on the failure event (the run settles, the session closes, the stream ends), or the test must fail before it waits.
+
+## Known places
+
+- RunPlaneCancelledRunQuestionTests: `.timeLimit`, and `deliveredAnswer` with `BoundedWait`.
+- RunPlaneUserWaitTests: `.timeLimit`.
+- MountFixtures `firstPendingElicitationId`: `AwaitedCondition`.
+- ElicitationEndEventTests: a wait that can hang when the end is not posted.
+
+The count of the peer: 26 `.timeLimit` and 34 `Task.sleep` in the test target. One full run. No repeated runs to find flakes. #test
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m532zec3355e3jpgts14ryhs
+  text: |-
+    Design (picked up, research done):
+    - New test helper Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/Waits.swift: Waits.untilFirstEnds(...) races the expected event with the fault event (call returns, run settles, task ends), then the test reads the state and expects. Waits.untilCancelled() replaces each "sleep for an hour" in fake tools.
+    - Recorder (ModelPoolTestSupport) gets waitUntil(condition): each append checks the waiters, so a test waits on a log entry with no poll. The wait ends at a cancel.
+    - MountFixtures.RecordingSink keeps events in eventLog/displayLog (Recorder), so a test waits for a post. firstPendingElicitationId and poll are gone: firstQuestionId(postedTo:orUntil:) waits for the elicitation event or the fault event.
+    - RunPlaneTestSupport: AnswerDrivenRun, AwaitedCondition and BoundedWait users move to QuestionTask: waitUntilAsked ends also when the asker ends; answer(on:) ends a question that is still open (endElicitation with a cancel) before it waits, so a lost answer fails the test and does not hang.
+    - CancellationFlagPollingTool becomes CancellationFlagTool: it waits for the task cancel, then reads ToolContext.isCancelled (ToolRun sets the flag before it cancels the call task). HeartbeatTool beats on a gate, not on a sleep.
+    - Real-time timeouts in library code (RunPlane() with ContinuousRunClock, mount timeout 0.2 s) stay: they are library behavior, not test sleeps.
+  timestamp: 2026-10-16T19:28:15.235244+00:00
